programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: Kate is part of a writing duo with her boyfriend, and thinks her author days are over when they split, until her publisher requests a sequel.

programme.title: Reluctant Nanny
programme.desc: A lone officer desperately seeks a nanny for two children awaiting foster care, while Libby, jobless in LA, grapples with her future. Their paths cross due to a petty theft.

programme.title: Twist of Fate
programme.desc: A man and a woman agree to meet after hitting it off on a phone call, but they keep missing each other for various reasons.

programme.title: Win, Lose or Love
programme.desc: A single mom and a widowed dad tie for the presidency of the PTA at their children's elementary school, where they engage in a power struggle and eventually realize they have feelings for each other.

programme.title: Bound & Babysitting
programme.desc: A couple need a babysitter so they can go on a much-needed romantic getaway, so they enlist the help of two friends who have been enemies since college in hopes that they realize how much they have in common.

programme.title: Love Takes Wing
programme.desc: A young doctor (Sarah Jones) moves to a town where a strange illness has stricken several residents, particularly those in the local orphanage. Despite their peril, the townspeople resist her efforts to help because she's a woman, so the doctor must find a way to save the town before it's too late. Haylie Duff, Cloris Leachman, Patrick Duffy. Directed by Lou Diamond Phillips, who also stars. Based on the novel by Janette Oke.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Sentimental tale of a proud widow (Ann-Margret) whose deteriorating sight impels her to take in a drifter (Matthew Settle) and his precocious daughter (Shailene Woodley). Gary Sandy, Hunter Tylo. Jan Kyles: Rebecca McFarland. Dave Jeeters: Sean O'Bryan. Sheriff Gorman: Christopher Murray.

programme.title: Hometown Hero
programme.desc: Romance develops when a cynical divorce mediator has to take care of a client's dog.

programme.title: This Magic Moment
programme.desc: An aspiring screenwriter pretends to date a starlet who's trying to make her ex jealous. As the duo keep up their ruse, the lines between fact and fiction begin to blur and romantic entanglements ensue.

programme.title: Time Capsule
programme.desc: After 10 years, a group of high school friends reunite at their alma mater's field house to dig up their time capsule. When they open the time capsule they decide to relive their fun high school moments which inspire a newfound relationship.

programme.title: Sweet Surrender
programme.desc: After spending years in the military, a young man returns to his hometown to take over operation of his ailing grandmother's bed-and-breakfast, where he must contend with an old flame who's scheming to get the property turned into a mall.

programme.title: Undercover Bridesmaid
programme.desc: A security agent goes undercover as a bridesmaid in order to protect a bride-to-be who's been receiving threatening letters leading up to her nuptials. As the agent works the case, she also forms a bond with a groomsman and learns a lesson about forgiveness.

programme.title: The Nanny Express
programme.desc: A spunky nanny (Vanessa Marcil) tries to win over her rebellious charges, who are coping with the death of their mother. Romance soon blooms between the nanny and the kids' father (Brennan Elliott), but the relationship could stall if the kids object. Dean Stockwell and Stacy Keach also star.

programme.title: Bound by a Secret
programme.desc: Dying actress Jane (Leslie Ann Warren) returns to her hometown to spend her final days with her best friend, Ida Mae (Meredith Baxter). Their respite hits a snag, though, when Jane decides to reveal that she's the biological mother of Ida Mae's daughter (Bridget Ann White). Timothy Bottoms also stars. Directed by David S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: Class
programme.desc: A rich law student (Justin Bruening) must help a single mom (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe) find a job with benefits as part of an assignment for his public-advocacy class. Though the pair clash at first, they soon realize they aren't so different and that they each need to go after the careers they truly want. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

Lonnie: Neil Patrick Harris. Billy: Kyle Chandler. Hilton: Wallace Wilkinson. Filmed in Georgia. Adapted by Robert Inman from his novel. Directed by Glenn Jordan.

programme.title: How Not to Propose
programme.desc: A guy plans a romantic weekend getaway to pop the question to his longtime love, but things hit a hitch.

programme.title: Secret Summer
programme.desc: Rachel, a NYC appraiser is sent to a small town to buy out a library so her client can build a resort. She meets Jake, a local writer who tries to convince her how important the library is to the small community but the arrival of his niece and nephew complicate his efforts.

programme.title: Oliver's Ghost
programme.desc: A young boy (Nicholas Stargel) befriends a ghost (Martin Mull) living in the attic of his family's new house in a small town. After several angry outbursts from the ghost, the boy tries to get to the bottom of what's plaguing him. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: The Cookie Mobster
programme.desc: A young mob member goes into the Witness Protection Program and settles into a quiet suburban village, where he falls for a local woman and gets involved with cookie-making fund-raising for her daughter's scout troop while dodging his former associates who have tracked him down.

programme.title: The Michaels
programme.desc: A manicurist predicts that an unlucky-at-love lawyer will meet the love of her life and he will be a Michael, so the attorney begins a series of dates with men with that name.

programme.title: Return to Sender
programme.desc: When a weathered old envelope appears in the mailbox of Meg's new apartment marked Return to Sender, she joins the building manager Ollie along with podcaster Ellen and partner Pete to find out who sent this mysterious love letter.

programme.title: Relative Stranger
programme.desc: After the death of his father, a former football hero who abandoned his family returns home after six years. His mother tries to mediate the conflict stirred up by his return as he faces his wife and children, whom he left behind.

programme.desc: A music teacher hires a struggling country singer to perform at her town's annual festival, but the musician's difficult behavior causes problems. The pair soon find common ground in music, however, and inspire each other to embark on new paths.

programme.title: Love on the Vines
programme.desc: A young lawyer works for six weeks at a vineyard to inherit it.

programme.title: Backyard Wedding
programme.desc: A med-school graduate (Alicia Witt) returns to her childhood home to plan her backyard wedding. Her ex-husband and former neighbor(Teddy Sears) is also in town, and his presence forces her to reevaluate how strong her current relationship truly is just days before the wedding. Directed by Bradford May.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: An urban lawyer travels to California horse country to learn more about her deceased father's past after she discovers he was once married to a rodeo star. The journey leads her to the woman's daughter, who's fighting to protect wild horses on her property.

programme.title: A Man for Every Month
programme.desc: An introvert journalist researches a magazine article by going out with different men every month.

programme.title: The Wish List
programme.desc: A perfectionist (Jennifer Esposito) makes a list of the qualities she's looking for in a mate and soon finds a seemingly ideal guy (Mark Deklin). But she's also drawn to a kooky barista (David Sutcliffe) who encourages her to loosen up and explore her creative side. Directed by Kevin Connor.

programme.title: Foxfire

Dillard: John Denver. Prince: Gary Grubbs. Holly: Harriet Hall. Filmed in Highlands, N.C., and Rabun County, Ga. Directed by Jud Taylor. Adapted by Susan Cooper, who co-wrote the original play with Cronyn.

Directed by David Burton Morris.

programme.title: Love Begins
programme.desc: An adventurer (Wes Brown) pays off a debt by working on a farm owned by a young woman (Julie Mond). As time passes and with nudging from the town's residents, the pair soon begin to fall for one another. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: Wedding Daze
programme.desc: Amiable family farce centers around the put-upon parents (John Larroquette, Karen Valentine) of three brides planning simultaneous nuptials. French Stewart, Marina Black. Teri: Jaime Ray Newman. Dahlia: Kelly Overton. Sam: Sebastian Tillinger. Lyle: James Waterston. Jake: Marc Hershon.

programme.title: Mr. Write

When a bite from a genetically modified spider gives Peter extraordinary powers, he is not only able to assert himself at school, but also resolves to use them to fight evil.

Also lurking in the shadows is his increasingly embittered and volatile old friend Harry Osborn.

programme.desc: Oscar-winning biographical drama starring Julia Roberts. When she loses a lawsuit following a car accident, unemployed single mother Erin Brockovich browbeats her lawyer, Ed Masry, into giving her a job. Soon she discovers that a power company has been dumping toxic waste and poisoning the residents of a small town. Masry's firm takes up the case - making Brockovich the unlikely linchpin in one of corporate America's biggest ever lawsuits.

Over the years, Dufresne's friendship with long-term inmate Red and the discovery that his financial expertise is suddenly in big demand make his ordeal easier to bear.

But when that mine plays out and he discovers oil, Plainview puts his energy into becoming a powerful oilman. This leads the ruthless, self-made tycoon to travel the country buying up drilling rights at cut-rate prices. However, when he encounters the preacher Eli Sunday, the destinies of the two men will be linked for years to come.
